verdict.rationale: FireHydrant ships AI features such as Copilot, summaries and AI-drafted retrospectives, so letting its AI consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence never shows FireHydrant acting as an MCP client or letting users plug in third-party MCP servers. The official FireHydrant MCP server exposes FireHydrant to other agents (server role) and does not count toward this client-side story.
